categories.entry_point: Unauthorized access to iCloud account data on Apple servers
categories.end_point: Access to iCloud data on Apple servers without authorization
categories.description: Access to iCloud data on Apple servers without authorization

tiers.description: Access to all iCloud data for multiple Apple Accounts. As an example, you demonstrate a vulnerability that grants you broad access to all iCloud data, such as iCloud Drive, Photos, Calendar, and encryption keys, for arbitrary Apple Accounts that are using all of our most advanced data protections (including two-factor authentication, Lockdown Mode, and Advanced Data Protection enabled, and "Access to iCloud Data on the Web" disabled).

Apple Account takeover that bypasses two-factor authentication. As an example, you demonstrate a vulnerability in the sign-in flow that achieves complete compromise of multiple Apple Accounts configured with two-factor authentication enabled, to access all iCloud Drive contents, Photos, and encryption keys. The attack also requires no user interaction or social engineering.

Limited unauthorized access of Apple Account iCloud data. As an example, you demonstrate a vulnerability that lets you access a subset of iCloud account features, such as iCloud Photos, on accounts you do not control.

categories.examples_text:
- **$1,000,000:** Access to all iCloud data for multiple Apple Accounts. As an example, you demonstrate a vulnerability that grants you broad access to all iCloud data, such as iCloud Drive, Photos, Calendar, and encryption keys, for arbitrary Apple Accounts that are using all of our most advanced data protections (including two-factor authentication, Lockdown Mode, and Advanced Data Protection enabled, and "Access to iCloud Data on the Web" disabled).
- **$250,000:** Apple Account takeover that bypasses two-factor authentication. As an example, you demonstrate a vulnerability in the sign-in flow that achieves complete compromise of multiple Apple Accounts configured with two-factor authentication enabled, to access all iCloud Drive contents, Photos, and encryption keys. The attack also requires no user interaction or social engineering.
- **$10,000:** Limited unauthorized access of Apple Account iCloud data. As an example, you demonstrate a vulnerability that lets you access a subset of iCloud account features, such as iCloud Photos, on accounts you do not control.

bonuses.topic: Beta software: issues unique to newly added features or code, including regressions

target_flags_note: Obtaining a specific reward requires confirmation with Target Flags where indicated. Rewards depend on demonstrated outcomes; a patched CVE is not itself eligible.
notes: Apple Security Bounty features the industry’s highest rewards for exploit chains that can achieve similar goals as sophisticated mercenary-spyware attacks. Rewards are determined by the outcomes you’re able to demonstrate with your report. Obtaining a specific reward requires confirmation with Target Flags where indicated. We provide bonus rewards for the most exceptional research, including vulnerabilities that bypass the specific protections of Lockdown Mode or are discovered in beta software.
mapping_policy: Likely category / heuristic, not eligibility. No reward is inferred from exploitation status. Missing entry-point or control evidence requires human review.

scope_notes.App sandbox escape: An app on iPhone; heuristic restricted to iOS/iPadOS releases with control or data outcomes.
scope_notes.Wireless: Apple-designed radio and application-processor control without interaction required; keywords alone do not qualify.
scope_notes.Physical: Locked device and extraction of sensitive data required.
scope_notes.macOS: Only explicit sandbox/TCC/Gatekeeper outcomes have published macOS-only rows; root or kernel control alone is not assigned an invented payout.
